thread:
morgan: Kicking off warmup for eu-south2 GPU region. Goal: kubeadm cluster bring-up + nodepool warmup for inference fleet. Main checks: CNI/MTU, node labels/taints, coreaddons health, basic perf smoke. ETA validation this afternoon.

ana: Sweet. What GPU SKU + node sizing are we targeting? Any hard budget caps?

morgan: Targeting H100 spot workers (4) + 1 on-demand spare; control plane on on-demand. Node label plan: `gpu=h100`, `tier=inference`. Replica plan can fall back to A100 if quota blocks.

devon: Which CNI? Last eu-south run had MTU issues + load balancer fragmentation.

jia: Planning Calico (BGP disabled, IPIP enabled). We'll force MTU 1400 via ipipMTU config to avoid fragmentation with the cloud LB.

morgan: Calico snippet I'm applying:```yaml
apiVersion: projectcalico.org/v3
kind: FelixConfiguration
spec:
  ipipMTU: 1400
  vxlanEnabled: false
```

ops-karen: Heads up — GPU quota in eu-south2 is tight. I opened ticket INC-4521 for quota bump; approval might be ~2hrs. If blocked, fallback to A100 pool and lower batch sizes.

morgan: Will add graceful routing fallback to the model routing policy so live traffic can hit A100 variants if H100 is unavailable.

deploy-bot: deploy-trigger: `kubeadm init` started on control-plane-1 :rocket:

devon: Suggested smoke tests after nodes join (quick list):
- verify nodes show labels: `kubectl get nodes --show-labels`
- check taints: `kubectl describe node <node> | grep -i taint`
- check calico daemonset: `kubectl -n kube-system get pods -l k8s-app=calico-node`
- schedule small GPU pod: `kubectl run dl-bench --image=ghcr.io/redwood/dl-bench:latest --requests='cpu=500m,memory=1Gi'`
- run 10 concurrent inference requests against local service (dl-bench)

ana: Add PV mount test too (we saw NFS mount latency in prior region). Also test egress to S3 endpoint in-region.

morgan: Running the smoke + perf now, will post summary.

morgan: Smoke summary: nodes joined 5/5, labels/taints OK, calico pods 3/3 ready, MTU enforced at 1400 on host interface, NFS mounts healthy, S3 egress ~85MB/s, dl-bench p50=12ms p95=45ms. Noted one spot node reclaimed at minute 9; cluster-autoscaler replaced with on-demand — cost delta ~+20% for first 24h. :white_check_mark:

ops-karen: Spot reclaim expected. Suggest ASG/scale settings: increase scale-down delay to 6m and keep 1 on-demand buffer in ASG. I'll file a follow-up ticket: https://tickets.internal/INC-4522

jia: Also opening a micro-task to try reduced-precision model profiles to lower per-model memory; could reclaim a worker and cut ~12% infra cost.

devon: Everything green for handoff to oncall once runbook updated. Please add calico MTU note + fallback policy steps in the runbook.

morgan: Will update `/runbooks/cluster-warmup.md` with MTU snippet, ASG recommendations, and the smoke checklist. Ping #oncall after update. Closing this thread unless new blockers. :thumbsup:
